Pb(NO3)2(aq)  +  2KI(aq)  →  PbI2(s)  +  2KNO3(aq)
1
2AgNO3(aq)  +  CuI2(aq)  →  Cu(NO3)2(aq)  +  2AgI(s)
2
CuO(s)  +  H2SO4(aq)  →  CuSO4(aq)  +  H2O(l)
3
Which reactions are suitable for making a salt by precipitation?
A
1 and 2 only
B
1 and 3 only
C
2 and 3 only
D
1, 2 and 3
